issues.description: Method parameter mismatch for Lecture.addGuestStudents: the problem statement (UML and task) and the solution implementation declare a single-parameter method addGuestStudents(int). The template repository provides a stub with a different signature that includes an extra boolean parameter: public void addGuestStudents(int numberOfNewGuestStudents, boolean validateInput). This inconsistency changes the method's parameter list, will prevent student code from matching the intended API and tests, and can cause compilation or test failures or confusion about the expected behavior.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the template API match the problem statement and solution: change the stub in src/de/tum/cit/ase/Lecture.java to public void addGuestStudents(int numberOfNewGuestStudents) { /* TODO: implement */ }. If additional validation is desired, implement it internally in that method or provide a clearly named internal/helper overload, but keep the single-argument public signature so student implementations and tests compile against the specified API.
